title: GEMglCopyPixels
description: copy pixels in the frame buffer

messages.description: window x of the lower left corner of the region to copy
window y of the lower left corner of the region to copy
width of the region to copy
height of the region to copy
whether color values, depth values, or stencil values are to be copied

arguments.description: window x of the lower left corner of the region to copy
window y of the lower left corner of the region to copy
width of the region to copy
height of the region to copy
whether color values, depth values, or stencil values are to be copied

body: [GEMglCopyPixels] calls glCopyPixels() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glCopyPixels in the OpenGL reference.
